extensions.description: Untrusted normal browser extension outputs, interpreted by webauthn-rs0.5.5.

email.description: NFC local part; preserve case/dots/plus; IDNA lowercased domain. Production email uses ASCII local parts and a real domain. Synthetic profiles require example.invalid.

publicKey.description: Standard creation options from webauthn-rs0.5.5; decode base64url challenge/user.id/credential IDs before navigator.credentials.create.

start.description: UTC RFC3339 instant with millisecond precision or coarser

bookingRecords.description: All retained bookings including cancelled; limit10000.

catalogObjects.description: Retained M1 resources + offerings; hours are excluded. Limit: min(catalog entitlement,1000).

committedEvents.description: Consumed retained event sequence budget; limit20000; no pruning/refund.

liveReplays.description: Only entries with expires_ms > asOf; limit4096. Existing24h per-record expiry; read never deletes expired rows.

monthlyBookingCreates.description: Committed M1 creates in the UTC month; replay, failure and cancellation do not consume/refund. Limit: current monthly_creates entitlement.

webhookDeliveries.description: All retained queue rows including terminal/suppressed; limit4096. Queued does not mean delivered.

webhookSubscriptions.description: All retained subscriptions including disabled; limit16.

UsagePeriod.description: Enclosing UTC calendar month, half-open: start <= asOf < end.

url.description: HTTPS hostname, port443; no IP, userinfo, query or fragment. Syntactic admission only; transport must validate DNS/address/redirect policy.

signingSecret.description: One-time base64url encoding of32 random bytes; response only, no replay storage.

WebhookDelivery.description: M4 additive attempt summary; fixed safe codes only, no lease token/payload/secret/target. Suppressed forbids future dispatch but may have an unknown admitted attempt. See m4-delivery.md.

bookingAccess.description: Client-generated32random bytes, canonical unpadded base64url43chars, Authorization: Booking TOKEN. One booking only; no customer/management authority. Keep private, use URL fragment only for the private management link.

contactReuse.description: Separate client-generated32random bytes/canonical base64url. First successful public book binds this proof to its new contact. Later creates may reuse only the exact current active contact on this page. No read/update/list/booking-management authority.397day bound, invalidated by restore.

info.description: Independent API-first rewrite. Secret bearer keys select one exact workspace/environment. Human APIs use same-origin browser/session cookies and CSRF, never bearer substitution. Bounded state, original2sHTTP deadline; failures/lost mutation replies can be unknown, never automatically resend. Booking keys retain24h receipts; other continuation rules are operation-specific. See API quickstart, privacy and retention policy.
